text: 金十期货8月20日讯，沪深300股指期货（IF）主力合约涨0.24%，上证50股指期货（IH）主力合约涨0.15%，中证500股指期货（IC）主力合约涨0.73%，中证1000股指期货（IM）主力合约涨0.76%。
text_en: Jinshi Futures August 20: The CSI 300 stock index futures (IF) main contract rose 0.24%, the SSE 50 stock index futures (IH) main contract rose 0.15%, the CSI 500 stock index futures (IC) main contract rose 0.73%, and the CSI 1000 stock index futures (IM) main contract rose 0.76%.
